description: Compare snow forecasts across 7 weather models (ECMWF, GFS, GEM, JMA, ICON, Météo-France, Met Norway) for a resort. Shows model agreement and uncertainty. Use for forecast reliability queries. The model table and days 8–14 need SnowSure Pro, or a favourite resort when signed in; otherwise this returns the seven-day blend alone.

resort.description: Same as `slug`: the resort slug or name. Pass either one.

slug.description: Resort slug or name, e.g. "portillo" or "Portillo". Required unless `resort` is given.

name: compare_forecasts

markdown.description: Human-readable markdown summary of the tool result (may be omitted when structuredContent carries a typed payload; content[0].text always has the prose).

title: Compare forecast models
